decisions.reason: Regular Enter as a date-entry alternative is distinct from using standard Enter to create line breaks in multiline text fields; the candidate's same-message date-field update is not a necessary cross-Requirement effect.
Adding keyboard entry to the date field does not change persistent labels, help-text content, locations, or visibility.
The date field's additional entry method does not change the checklist-and-dropdown control configuration.
The source changes how a date value may be entered, not whether placeholder text clears when a field is activated.
Adding regular date input does not alter the required visible instructional cue for editable fields.
The source decision concerns date-entry interaction and does not change preservation of Title-field formatting.
The client requests an additional date-entry method without specifying any change to the general field implementation architecture.
Date-value entry does not affect text wrapping or adjacent-column stability.
The additional date-entry method does not replace or modify the Danish date-field placeholder or other localized text.
The date-entry change has no necessary effect on text-to-border spacing.
Regular Enter input for a date field is distinct from Enter creating a new bullet in a controlled bullet area.
Allowing regular date entry does not change alignment of Board Meeting fields.
